source: Fuji Japanese Restaurant — Complete Profile & Website Planning Brief (menu transcribed from https://fujirestaurant.co.uk/menu)
allergenNotice: Our kitchen handles fish, gluten, soy, sesame and shellfish. All salad dressings (including the bento salad dressing) contain nuts. Dietary labels are reproduced from the restaurant's published menu — please always tell staff about allergies before ordering. We cannot guarantee any dish is free from allergens or cross-contamination.
